parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: This is the spherical part of the globe made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed maps. It is approximately 25 cm in diameter.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the main display surface for geographical information and can rotate around its axis for viewing different regions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates smoothly around the tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base and supporting frame of the globe, made of plastic, providing stability and holding the rotating sphere in place.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the globe sphere and allows it to rotate around its axis while keeping it elevated and stable on a flat surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the sphere rotates around the axis attached to it.
